First, I'll click on the 'Reports' link in the menubar. Then, I'll navigate to the Sales section within Reports, and then to Orders. async def act(page):
    # Click on the Reports link in the menubar
    await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="Reports").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Navigate to Sales under Reports
    # Assuming the Reports page has a link to Sales
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Sales").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Navigate to Orders under Sales Reports
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Orders").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Set the date range for last year (2022)
    # Assuming there are date input fields with specific roles or names
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="From").fill("01/01/2022")
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="To").fill("12/31/2022")
    
    # Click the Show Report button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Show Report").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Wait for the report to load completely
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    
    # Return the report data as-is
    # Assuming the report is displayed in a table or similar element
    report_data = await page.content()
    return report_data
